title: Localization of T cell clonotypes using the Visium spatial transcriptomics platform
author: Hudson, Sudmeier
materials: Bioanalyzer with high sensitivity DNA kit
Qubit instrument with dsDNA HS Assay kit
Dual Index Kit TT Set A sample index primers

steps.title: Embed and section tissue
steps.instruction: Embed freshly resected human brain metastasis samples in OCT and freeze them according to the 10x Genomics Visium manufacturer’s protocols.

steps.title: Place sections on Visium slide
steps.instruction: Cut 10 μm thick sections, place each section onto a Visium Gene Expression Slide.

steps.title: Stain and image sections
steps.instruction: Stain the sections with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) following the Visium manufacturer’s protocol, then image the stained sections on a Cytek Lionheart microscope at 10× magnification in color bright‑field mode.

steps.title: Generate Visium cDNA
steps.instruction: Generate cDNA from the Visium Gene Expression Slide according to the 10x Genomics Visium protocol (step 3 of the 2022 protocol), yielding a 40 μL cDNA eluate.

steps.title: Allocate cDNA for TCR work
steps.instruction: Reserve 5 μL of the amplified cDNA for the TCR‑β targeted amplification; note that 10 μL of the 40 μL eluate is used for the standard gene‑expression library, leaving ~30 μL available for TCR work.

steps.title: Amplify TCRβ with primer pool
steps.instruction: Set up a PCR using the 30 μL cDNA as template, a pool of 45 human TRBV primers (each primer has a 5′ partial Illumina Read 2 sequence) and a Read 1 primer; run the PCR to generate a TCR‑enriched library that retains the CDR3 region together with the spatial barcode and UMI.

steps.title: Purify TCR‑enriched library
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR product with bead purification (no fragmentation step, to preserve linkage between TCR sequence and spatial barcode).

steps.title: Add sample indexes
steps.instruction: Perform a sample‑index PCR on the bead‑purified TCR‑enriched library to introduce Illumina index adapters for multiplexed paired‑end sequencing.

steps.title: Sequence libraries paired‑end
steps.instruction: Sequence the indexed library on an Illumina platform using paired‑end reads: Read 1 contains the N16 spatial barcode plus N12 UMI; Read 2 contains the TCR CDR3 region.

steps.title: Analyze reads with MiXCR
steps.instruction: Run MiXCR on Read 2 to identify TCR clones; use the paired Read 1 to assign each clone to its spatial barcode and deduplicate reads using the UMI.
